overall: The AG found violations for untimely minute approval, missing document lists in minutes, and a late response to a minutes request, but no violation on recording notice, website posting, minute accuracy, or the warrant-article omission; other allegations were declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair did not announce at the Feb 9, 2016 meeting that it was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board posted a sign notifying the public that the meeting was recorded, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve certain minutes and post them to the Town website.
allegations.key_passage: the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to post minutes to a website because that is not a requirement under the law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve several sets of meeting minutes.
allegations.key_passage: the Board stalled on approving certain minutes for months.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the October 13 and October 27, 2015 minutes were inaccurate and omitted statements and discussion.
Complaint alleged the October 13, 2015 minutes should have noted the Board took no action on a warrant article.
allegations.key_passage: the minutes should only reflect what was actually discussed at the meeting, rather than what the Board failed to discuss.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the minutes at issue failed to include a list of documents used at each meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board used documents during each meeting at issue, we order the Board to revise the minutes, as planned, to include such a list.

allegations.summary: Complainant requested minutes after the Feb 9, 2016 meeting and alleged the Board failed to respond within 10 days.
allegations.key_passage: By failing to provide the minutes to the complainant after her request, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair did not follow Robert's Rules of Order at the February 9, 2016 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review, and offer no opinion on, whether there was a violation of any other law or policy.

allegations.summary: Complainant's later July 2016 letter raised allegations not included in the original complaint filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review any additional allegations set forth for the first time in this letter.

remedy: Approve the November 10, 2015 meeting minutes within thirty (30) days, if not already done.
Within 30 days, revise the minutes at issue to include the list of documents used during each meeting.
Provide the requested minutes to the complainant within 10 days of receipt of the determination.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
